name: WD Technology DOCX Framework
description: Reusable Node.js framework for generating professional DOCX documents. Eliminates rebuilding document generation logic each session. Includes helpers, styles, tables, template, and PDF generator. Command: node run.js --format docx --content content/my_content.js. Source: frameworks/wd-docx-framework/ (this repo).
author: aswin@wdtechnologysolutions.com

changelog.note: Original artifact registered. Metadata only — source code from this version was not present in a later session (2026-08-07), likely due to being built in a separate working environment.

Framework rebuilt from the documented interface (helpers, styles, tables, template, PDF generator via LibreOffice). Tested end-to-end: docx and PDF generation both confirmed working. Source now lives in this repo at frameworks/wd-docx-framework/ so it can be genuinely reused rather than re-described.
